column1: # Translations from English Wiktionary's translation tables that import_wiktionary.py --translations
# turns down: Russian words, surzhyk and other mistakes a person has read and rejected.
# check_russianisms.py lists candidates; only what someone has looked at goes here, written by hand.
# One row per word: the spelling (stress marks are ignored), a tab, and the part of speech as the
# tables give it (noun, verb, adj, adv, ...). Leave the part of speech out to turn the spelling down
